L109: # Thiamine Vitamin Component Recipe
L110: 
L111: #### Directions
L112: 
L113: #### For 200 mL Total
L114: 
L115:   1. Prepare 200 mL of HEPES buffer (50 mM).
L116:   2. Adjust the pH to 7.8.
L117:   3. Add Thiamine (1 mM) wait until fully dissolved.
L118:   4. Sterilize by 0.45 µm Millipore filter. Store in dark at freezer temperature.
L119: 
L120: **The amount of vitamins can vary from medium to medium so the final concentration is not listed.
L121: #  | Component  | Amount  | Stock Solution Concentration  | Final Concentration
L122: --- | --- | --- | --- | ---
L123: 1  | HEPES buffer pH 7.8
L124: (Sigma H-3375)  | 2.4 g/200 mL dH_{2}O  | 50 mM  | **
L125: 2  | Thiamine
L126: (Sigma T-1270)  | 0.067 g/200 mL dH_{2}O  | ~ 1 mM  | **
